title: WorldAgen: Unified State-Action Prediction with Test-Time World Model Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.08162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How can vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt to new environments where world dynamics shift? While recent research has combined world modeling and action prediction to improve VLA performance, existing methods largely rely on pretraining on static datasets, without mechanisms for active adaptation at deployment time. As a result, these models often fail to generalize when deployed in unseen scenarios with novel object configurations or dynamics. We present WorldAgen, a unified framework that jointly learns world modeling and action prediction while enabling Test-Time Training (TTT) to adapt to new environments. WorldAgen employs a shared Transformer backbone with two heads: (1) a world model head that predicts future states from past state-action trajectories, and (2) an agent model head that predicts actions conditioned on task instructions. translated_title: WorldAgen：基于测试时世界模型训练的统一状态-动作预测
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型如何适应世界动态发生变化的新环境？尽管近期研究已将世界建模与动作预测相结合以提升VLA的性能，但现有方法大多依赖于在静态数据集上的预训练，缺乏在部署阶段主动适应的机制。因此，当这些模型被部署到具有新颖物体配置或动态特性的未见场景时，往往难以泛化。我们提出了WorldAgen，这是一个统一框架，能够联合学习世界建模与动作预测，同时启用测试时训练（TTT）以适应新环境。WorldAgen采用共享的Transformer主干网络，并配备两个头：（1）世界模型头，从过去的状态-动作轨迹预测未来状态；（2）智能体模型头，根据任务指令预测动作。我们设计了混合单向注意力掩码来分离这两个模型。在测试时（摘要此处被截断）……
tldr: WorldAgen提出了一个统一框架，通过共享Transformer主干联合学习世界建模与动作预测，并借助测试时训练（TTT）使VLA模型能够主动适应世界动态变化的新环境。
en_tdlr: WorldAgen introduces a unified framework that jointly learns world modeling and action prediction via a shared Transformer backbone, enabling Test-Time Training (TTT) to actively adapt VLA models to new environments with shifted world dynamics.
